question: _______ is the pattern of veins in the blade of a leaf.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Venation**__.

__
 
• **Venation **__**__is the pattern of veins in the blade of a leaf__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The arrangement of **veins** in a leaf is called **venation**. In **monocots**, the veins show **parallel venation**, while in **dicots**, the **veins** show **reticulate venation.**
 
• Within **each leaf**, the **vascular tissue** forms **veins**. The arrangement of veins in a leaf is called the **venation pattern.**
 
• In **monocot leaves**, the v**eins run parallel to each other.** Such leaves are said to have **parallel venation**.
 
 
• Example: banana, grass, and wheat.
 
 
 
• In **dicot leaves**, the veins, and veinlets are** irregularly distributed** over the entire lamina, forming a network.
 
 
• Example: mango and peepal.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
